title: The public footer and llms.txt stop advertising members-only marketplace pages (SCAN-1025)
detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-22. /market, /classifieds, /housing and /store redirect an anonymous visitor and are noindex, yet the public footer linked them on every page, in its navigation JSON-LD, and llms.txt told answer engines to crawl them. The Marketplace footer column and the llms.txt Marketplace section are gone; they return when the indexes are public. The Guides column now also links how-to-be-more-social and calm-down-fast, which had no inbound link.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const n=fs.readFileSync('lib/frequency/site-nav.ts','utf8');const l=fs.readFileSync('app/llms.txt/route.ts','utf8');const bad=[];if(n.includes(\"heading: 'Marketplace'\"))bad.push('footer still has a Marketplace column');if(l.includes('## Marketplace'))bad.push('llms.txt still lists the marketplace');if(!n.includes('/calm-down-fast')||!n.includes('/how-to-be-more-social'))bad.push('guides missing from the footer');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-1025: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when members-only marketplace indexes return to the public footer or llms.txt, or the two guides lose their footer link.
